Luke.java is a command-line task manager chatbot designed to help users organise and track todos (tasks), deadlines, and events efficiently.
It supports persistent storage, keyword searching, and date/time management using simple text commands.
No GUI required — fast keyboard workflow.
3. Open terminal in the jar folder.
Luke.java will create/save your tasks in: `data/luke_list.txt` (relative to where you run the jar).
You should see ascii art format of the name "LUKE", and following responses.
What can I do for you?
Got it. I've added this task:
Now you have 1 tasks in the list
Adds a deadline task with a required `/by`.
Luke displays deadlines in a friendly format, e.g.:
Got it. I've added this task:
Now you have 13 tasks in the list
### 3) Add an event (with start/end date & time)
Adds an event task with required `/from` and `/to`.
Got it. I've added this task:
Now you have 3 tasks in the list
Shows all tasks in your list.
Here are the tasks in your list:
Marks the task at the given index.
Nice! I've marked this task as done:
Marks the task as not done.
OK! I've marked this task as not done yet:
Deletes the task at the given index.
Now you have 2 tasks in the list
Shows tasks whose description contains the keyword.
Here are the matching tasks in your list:
Bye. Hope to see you again soon!
- If the file/folder doesn’t exist, Luke will create it.
- If you run the jar in a different folder, Luke will create a new `data/` folder there (this is expected).
Luke provides helpful messages when commands are entered incorrectly.
This helps users recover quickly from common mistakes.
OOPS!!! Please use the format: deadline <description> /by <time>.
OOPS!!! Task number is invalid here. Please check again
OOPS!!! I'm sorry, but I don't know what that means :-(
